name: Order_Aggregation1
_about: Field added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (03 Fulfillment / 04 Order Aggregation and Pre-Delivery Gate, OA-R2): confirms all of the package's boxes are physically at the loading area. Owner decision 2026-11-21: the package.aggregated Stage_Events stamp keeps firing on arrival at the Order Aggregation stage (unchanged, the Scoreboard and Delivery Analytics #7 both read it) -- this field is a separate widget-side confirmation gate, not a new stamp.

fields.name: Aggregated
fields.label: Aggregated (all boxes at loading area)
fields.helpText: OA-R2: check this once every box of the package is confirmed at the loading area. The widget asks for this before Dispatch Selected can be checked.
